levels.notes: The level has 12 boulders and 10 pits, leaving 2 spare boulders. Pick up the two scrolls of earth as soon as possible to ensure that no monsters get a hold of them; remember to verify their beatitude before reading them in Sokoban, and only do so if you have misplaced or broken some other boulders.

There are 10 boulders and 9 pits, leaving one spare boulder. Pick up the two scrolls of earth as soon as possible to ensure that no monsters get a hold of them; remember to verify their beatitude before reading them in Sokoban, and only do so if you have misplaced or broken some other boulders. Remember to check under the A boulder for possible usable objects; note that you can now push it diagonally if you want to use it after clearing the level.

This level is often considered one of the hardest levels of the original set of 8. There are 16 boulder and 12 holes, leaving 4 spare boulders. The key to this level is being able to walk around the shape in the bottom right. The level is now finished, but you will still need to move the A or C blocks to walk between your finishing position (as well as the stairs up) and the stairs down.
There are 20 boulders and 15 holes, leaving 5 spare boulders. Make way to the fourth room (lower right) by storing boulders in earlier rooms.
This version of the third level of Sokoban has 16 boulders and 11 holes. The opening move is the only one possible. Make sure you move the O boulder out of the way when finishing the L boulder.

There are 13 boulders and 10 holes, leaving 3 spare boulders. Clear the lower left, make sure you move J to the right and do L before J, then clear A and B. Clearing the top room is probably the hardest part of the level. Remember to check under and behind the unmoved boulders for usable items.

Behind the holes is a treasure zoo with three doors - inside one of the doors is the branch prize, which has an equal chance of being a bag of holding or an amulet of reflection. There are 18 boulders and 16 holes, leaving 2 spare boulders. In the large room behind the door is a treasure zoo. Behind one of the three doors in the zoo is a square with the prize item atop a burnt "Elbereth" and a cursed scroll of scare monster.

Behind the holes is a treasure zoo with three doors - inside one of the doors is the branch prize, which has an equal chance of being a bag of holding or an amulet of reflection. There are 20 boulders and 18 holes, leaving two spare boulders. The general strategy for this level is to enter through the right room into the middle of the left room. Behind one of the three doors in the zoo is a square with the prize item atop a burnt "Elbereth" and a cursed scroll of scare monster.
